basic_info.description: Great price on this Top Floor spacious two bedroom and two bathroom condominium townhome. Very private and serene large open space living with skylight, fireplace and bay windows overlooking courtyard and swimming pool. In unit washer and dryer. Downstairs are two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Large rooms with excellent closet space. Enjoy all of the benefits of Opera Plaza including on-site management, 24 hour security staff, concierge, 24 hour heated pool and spa, fitness and more. Best central San Francisco location is close to City Hall, cultural venues, transportation and freeways. HOA fee includes water, garbage, high speed internet, building maintenance and insurance, including earthquake insurance, and amenities. Optional leased parking on site.
